questions_to_append.topic: Part Lifecycle: the close X on status confirmations
questions_to_append.question: The design draws a close X at the top right of every status confirmation (Deactivate part?, Activate part?, Deactivate parts?, Activate parts?). The PRD lists only a title, a message, an optional note, Cancel and a confirm button. (a) Should the X be there? (b) If yes, does clicking it do the same as Cancel (nothing changes, and from the part window the picked status is kept)?
questions_to_append.options:
A) Keep the X; it acts as Cancel.
B) No X: title, message, note, Cancel and the confirm button only.
sources: PRD v33 §4 Key Decisions: "Every confirmation is the application's standard dialog. A title, a message, an optional note, Cancel and a confirm button."
SV-10823 UI/UX: "Standard confirmation with title, message lines, optional note, Cancel and a red Deactivate or blue Activate button."

questions_to_append.topic: Part Lifecycle: the note on design board 7.2
questions_to_append.question: The note on design board 7.2 still says a Part Library entry "can be edited and deleted" on its page, while the PRD (S11-R3) says the page itself has no Delete button and Delete sits in the Edit Library Part window. The board's picture shows no Delete. Can you confirm the PRD is right and the note is out of date? Our cases follow the PRD.
questions_to_append.options:
A) The PRD is right; the note is out of date.
B) The page should have a Delete button.
sources: Design board 7.2 note: "Clicking a row opens the entry, where it can be edited and deleted (S11-R3)."

questions_to_append.topic: Part Lifecycle: long Part History entries
questions_to_append.question: When a Part History entry is long (for example a part number change ending "| Changed at: <location>"), the design (board 2.6) wraps it onto a second line inside the Event column. The engineering plan cuts the Event text off with "..." instead. Which is right: (a) wrap onto more lines, or (b) cut off with "..."? If (b), how does a user read the full entry?
questions_to_append.options:
A) Wrap onto more lines (as the design).
B) Cut off with "..." (as the tech plan).
sources: PRD v33 S10-R21 (silent on wrap or cut-off)
Design board 2.6 note: "Staff, Date and Time keep their production widths; a long Event wraps onto a second line."
Tech plan Phase 8, PartHistory.vue: "S10-R21: fixed headerStyle widths on Staff/Date/Time, Event elastic, table-layout: fixed + ellipsis (the Inventory list approach)"
